context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “A cry, divided garments, and a watching assembly” preserves a distinct antecedent source unit within anticipation.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The psalm moves from a cry of abandonment through bodily distress, mockery, divided garments, appeal, praise, and a widening assembly.
observations.label: A cry, divided garments, and a watching assembly: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps language, body, garments visible within its Crucifixion evidence.
observations.label: A cry, divided garments, and a watching assembly: action, promise, or consequence

payload.posture: Read Psalms 22:1–31 as its own anticipation and stated approach crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
payload.title: A cry, divided garments, and a watching assembly
